author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Cursed Realm launch trailer for Kristala, a dark fantasy action soulslike RPG developed by Astral Clocktower Studios. Step into Kristala's biggest free content update yet, introducing an all-new NPC and questline, mysterious Cursed Rifts, long-requested customization features, Transmogrification, a magic Mirror mechanic, Keozan-inspired equipment set, and much more.
The Cursed Realm update is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Kristala - Official Cursed Realm Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for LEGO Party!, and compete against your friends in wacky Challenge Zones and 60 hilarious minigames from across your favorite LEGO sets like Pirates, Space, NINJAGO, and more. LEGO Party! is available now for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: LEGO Party! - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Starsand Island, a life simulation RPG developed by Seed Sparkle Lab. Players will live out the calm country life in Starsand Island, explore the sights, create relationships, and engage in a variety of activities, such as home building, decorating, seasonal festivals, cooking, and more. Starsand Island is launching on August 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Starsand Island - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Seer Class Reveal trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. Seers draw strength from their faith in the return of the gods, using prayers and divine arts to heal, protect, and support allies. Their attacks consume energy charges, while empowered attacks spend multiple charges for stronger effects. By conjuring runes, shielding allies, concealing them, binding enemies, and wielding both light and wind, Seers provide versatile support and control, though they can struggle when overwhelmed or locked down. Mistfall Hunter is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Seer Class Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Withered Knight Spear & Shield Class Reveal trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. The Spear & Shield style gives the Withered Knight a more defensive and forward-driving approach. By raising the shield, blocking attacks, charging forward, and following with spear thrusts or shield strikes, this style can advance under pressure while creating openings. Several spear-and-shield skills also apply Wither directly, allowing the Withered Knight to combine defense, control, and sustained follow-up attacks. Mistfall Hunter is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Withered Knight Spear & Shield Class Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Withered Knight Class Reveal trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. The Withered Knight’s combat revolves around applying Wither and triggering it through heavy attacks and certain skills. When Wither is detonated, it deals damage, restores Energy, and reduces cooldowns, creating a rhythm built around marking, striking, and following up. With attacks, parries, and guidance-based skills, the Withered Knight steadily builds pressure while turning each opening into a chance to continue the assault. Mistfall Hunter is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Withered Knight Class Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Shadowstrix Class Reveal trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. Shadowstrix uses stealth, shadow-based movement, and fast melee strikes to create sudden openings in battle. Skills such as Sneak, Crow Storm, Shadow Strike, Flurry Strike, Phantom Shift, and Bloody Blade Dance support a combat style built around approaching, striking, repositioning, and continuing pressure. With Shadow Veil and afterimage-related effects, Shadowstrix can turn mobility and timing into repeated attack opportunities. Mistfall Hunter is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Shadowstrix Class Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Sorcerer Class Reveal trailer for Mistfall Hunter, an upcoming dark fantasy extraction shooter developed by Bellring Games. Players can get the rundown on Sorcerers, who wield complex spells through arcane chants, gestures, and magical tools. Sorcerers can unleash powerful magic at a distance while also relying on arcane defenses and movement techniques to survive dangerous encounters. With spells such as ice, fire, lightning, barriers, and gravity magic, Sorcerers control the flow of battle through precise casting and timing. Fight as a Sorcerer in Mistfall Hunter, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Sorcerer Class Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Not a Dog announcement trailer for this upcoming adventure RPG. What will the world look like on behalf of a cute little dog driven by a cherished wish? Will you follow your dream or stay with your beloved owner, find a new life, or greet the dawn with your loyal friend? Not a Dog will be available on PC.
title: Not a Dog - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Gamebeat announcement trailer for this upcoming chess roguelike deckbuilder where you play for points, not kings. Start with pawns, end with clowns. Build a roster of evolving pieces, stack game-breaking Stickers, and chain together absurd high scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder, Gamebeat. Gamebeat will be available on PC.
title: Gamebeat - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for 9 Yin Sutra, an open-world action-adventure RPG developed by Snail Games USA. Players will set out in a vibrant world to seek the mysteries of eternal life. Craft artifacts of legend, master the mystic arts, and seek long-forgotten knowledge along the way. 9 Yin Sutra is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: 9 Yin Sutra - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, a bullet heaven action roguelite RPG developed by Games FARM and ARTillery. Players will take on hordes of enemies to overcome the test of a God. Complete map objectives, explore new abilities, and survive the ultimate showdown. Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is available now for Nintendo Switch 2 alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!, a 3D anime arcade driving platformer developed by Strange Scaffold. title: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?! - Official Launch Trailer
